title: generateIds
body:
## generateIds

Adds arrays holding each point's and each cell's index (zero-based ids in the input), so that later clipping, extraction or merging carries the original ids along and results can be traced back to the source mesh. The geometry and type are unchanged and existing arrays are kept; each generated id array becomes that attribute's active scalars. For hyper-tree grids cell ids are always generated, and pointIds, pointName and cellIds have no effect.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Ids are indices in this node's input, not solver-native ids; apply the operation before filters that renumber points or cells.

Native constructor: `PointAndCellIds`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pointIds` | Enable generation of point ids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `cellIds` | Enable generation of cell ids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `pointName` | The name of the point ids array. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1}` | `"pointIds"` | `"pointIds"` |
| `cellName` | The name of the cell ids array. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1}` | `"cellIds"` | `"cellIds"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "generateIds",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
